ns2:course.label: Aerospace Dynamics
ns2:course.description: (A A E 250) Particle kinematics and dynamics; Lagrange's equations; vibration of multiple degree-of-freedom systems; rotational kinematics and dynamics of rigid bodies Credit is not given for both AE 352 and TAM 412. Prerequisite: AE 252, MATH 225 and MATH 385.
